analyticEqualities.source: The exact same original leading slow F is used at the representative and evaluation point; every positive-order field vanishes on the shared open terminal exterior.
analyticEqualities.axial: The same privately moment-restored U/M/V vanish identically after Xv. The selected terminal neighborhood lies after Xplus>Xv. Thus actual G=G_R=G_Z=0, with their full original roots retained.
analyticEqualities.evenness: On the original terminal stage all preceding local repairs have ended, and the complete F is Ecl(X)*H(2*(1-eta^2)/X)/sqrt(2X). Ecl and the original gamma density are eta independent. The heat factor is even in eta. The unique original chart s-Z^2*s^(2h)-T=0 is even in Z. At Z=0,T=1 this proves F_Z=0 and s=1 on the actual smooth chart.
analyticEqualities.frame: The source FR is negative, hence with GR=0, N=(-1,0),K=(0,-1),gabs=-R*FR. The retained positive square root gives lambda0^2=2F*(gabs-2F); c0=-lambda0/(2F). Thus gamma=-c0>0, alpha=gamma^2, lambda0=2F*gamma, gabs=2F*(1+alpha).
analyticEqualities.phase: p and pz are frozen in slow coordinates. HR=p*FR+pz*GR=-(Bs*gabs)*b and HZ=p*FZ+pz*GZ=0, with b=p/(R*Bs). No phase carrier is replaced by its unrounded value.

derivation.frequency: ell>=(64/h)^2 gives h*sqrt(ell)>=64. log2>1/2 and log(ell)<sqrt(ell) for ell>=8 imply log(k)>=h*ell*log2/2>16*sqrt(ell)>16*log(ell)=8*log(S), hence k>S^8. No giant integer or positive h is rounded.
derivation.scalar: Since w_plus>0, d_tau log(w_plus)=Ls*M11+Ls*M12*(w_minus/w_plus). The exact reduced diagonal differs from -(3/2)*s*sign*u/(1+s^2) by at most B^14/S; the full coupling is at most B^516/S.
derivation.damping: epsilon*k^2*Bs^2=lambda0/(1+u^2)^(3/2). Thus|Ls*(damping-dref)|<=B*Ls*(b^2+(2u+1)|sA-s|); its sign is not discarded.
derivation.reference: Aref=((1+u^2/4)/(1+u^2))^(3/4). The inner ratio is1/4+3/(4*(1+u^2)); on[1/4,1], the derivative of x^(3/4) is<3, so0<Aref-1/(2*sqrt2)<3/u^2.
derivation.exponential: For |e|<=1/2, |exp(e)-1|<=2|e|. Aref<=1, hence|a_sign-1/(2*sqrt2)|<=2*halfLog+3/u^2<2^-8192. Every remainder is strictly positive.

proof.fullSolution: The invariant cone is proved for the same full original system and w_plus(0)=1. Integrating its actual scalar logarithmic equation includes M12*w_minus/w_plus. The limiting diagonal is an explicit comparison, never the actual matrix or a substituted solution.
proof.originalRounding: At slow=representative, b=b0+delta_b with b0=sign*u/(Ls*gabs). The unrounded tilt controls only a difference bound. The actual p, nonzero rounded integer, pz, positive epsilon, h and ell remain in the original system and every exact center root.
proof.sourceNormalization: An appended exact congruence identifies each original all-equal smooth-piecewise branch with its common value; every original matrix, rounding value and nonconstant branch is retained. Simultaneous replacement of complete operands then verifies all four complete matrix entries against the same actualMovingPulseFrame routine with the source midplane identities. Positive Bs removes only a common normal scale. The generic hyperbola proof applies to every finite exact b, including the retained rounded one.
proof.bound: The actual log center differs from log Aref by at most halfLog>0. Aref differs from1/(2sqrt2) by at most3/u^2>0. The combined absolute radius is bounded by2^-8192. Directed BigInt square roots and outward arithmetic enclose each actual center, its square and inverse square.
proof.covariance: Multiply the earlier directed source-normalized mass/H intervals by these actual a_sign^2 intervals, and divide the inverse coefficients by them. This removes the previously uncomputed Volterra center factors. The original positive massScale, Ac, u and tau remain exact expressions.
proof.limitations: Only the two full centers and radial pulse amplitude at this fixed original terminal witness are absolutely numerically enclosed. H/y coefficients still retain their explicit positive target and geometric scales. Slow/mixed/fast derivative values, the full physical curl numerical enclosure, all labels and global residual are not certified here.
